item.title: Kevin Bacon, Kathy Bates, Ron Howard, Barack Obama, and more respond to death of Rob Reiner: ‘The reason I became an actor’
item.description: Stars are honoring the legendary director and actor, who was found dead at age 78 alongside his wife, Michele Singer Reiner, in their Los Angeles home.

item.title: ‘Wake Up Dead Man’ composer Nathan Johnson unleashes a gothic new sound for the ‘Knives Out’ series
item.description: From scraping strings to unearthly textures, the composer breaks down the bold sonic choices that define Rian Johnson’s haunting new mystery.

item.title: Here’s your ‘Avatar’ catch-up guide before you head back to Pandora with ‘Fire and Ash’
item.description: What's up with that whale fluid? And who is Spider again? Gold Derby brings you up to speed on the events of the Avatar series ahead of Fire and Ash.

item.title: ‘Mr. Nobody Against Putin’ codirector David Borenstein: ‘Democratic values like free thought and free speech aren’t given’
item.description: The documentarian spoke about working with codirector Pasha Talankin to chart the rise of militarization in a small Russian town.

item.title: ‘The Voice’ recap: Top 6 perform for America’s vote in ‘Live Finale’
item.description: Artists from Team Bublé, Team Reba, Team Niall, and Team Snoop sing one contemporary and one classic song.

item.title: After making it big as a director, Rob Reiner finally felt comfortable returning to his original first love: TV acting
item.description: From All in the Family to New Girl and The Bear, the late filmmaker spent his final 16 years embracing character work and cameo comedy across the small screen.
